newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 14.

text.p: The House of Commons will stage a debate on Hong Kong on Thursday, less than eight months before sovereignty of the British colony is returned to China.
Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind will open the debate at around 1600 GMT.
-- Questions to the Northern Ireland Secretary at 1430 GMT.
-- Questions to the Prime Minister at 1515 GMT.
-- Statement on future business at 1530 GMT.
-- Press conference on the launch of a book on the life of Democratic Unionist leader Ian Paisley, 1115 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
